sources: Official trophy list as published on PSN (psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi) and Exophase (exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/) — names, descriptions and grades are taken from those lists verbatim.
Guides below are written in the author's own words from the official descriptions; every guide cites the official description as its source.

roadmap.title: Story
roadmap.note: Play the main story from Gone Fishing to the final mission. Do not finish the final mission until phase 2 is done.

roadmap.title: Missables
roadmap.note: Clear the 5 missable trophies (partner, choice or one-off moment) before the final mission. Keep a save from before any story choice.

roadmap.title: Activities
roadmap.note: Shooting Range, drone races, races, fishing, arcade, stranger strands, bowling and the Scooter Bros app. None is missable.

roadmap.title: Collectibles & exploration
roadmap.note: Meditation spots, card sets, WAiNK locations, vehicles and exploring all of Leonida. Sweep the map region by region.

roadmap.title: Combat, heists & money
roadmap.note: Combat Focus, bank vaults, armored trucks, gang operations, the jewelry store, stunts, challenges, laundering, spending and garages.

roadmap.title: Platinum
roadmap.note: Vice Got a Price! pops automatically once the other 54 are earned; A Long Road (100% Completion) is usually the last one standing.

trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. Follow the roadmap in this guide — story first, then collectibles and activities — and this one pops last, with nothing extra to do.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. This is the first story mission, so it unlocks naturally at the start of the game; there is nothing to prepare and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Only main-story progress counts — side content is not required for this one, so keep following the story missions.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Chapter completion is tracked automatically, so just keep playing the main story until the chapter closes.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. As with the other chapters, this one comes from main-story progress alone — no collectibles or side missions needed.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Keep following the story missions; the chapter trophy pops when the chapter's final mission is done.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Before you do, clear the missable trophies flagged in this guide (the partner and choice ones), because some setups may not be available once the story is over.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It is a named story mission — follow the main story until it appears, then play it through.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story heist mission — it arrives through main-story progress, and finishing it is all the trophy asks.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Another named story mission — keep playing the main story and it will come up.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Follow the main story until this mission appears, then finish it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission set around the airport — it unlocks through main-story progress.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Play the main story until this mission is offered, then complete it.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's completion checklist. This is the long one — completion counts story, side missions, collectibles and activities together, so clear the collectible and activity trophies first and use this tracker to find what is left; the last few percent are usually the hidden collectibles.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses and airtime, whatever the game counts as a stunt. They add up across free roam, so a fast bike and the ramps around Vice City turn this into a steady grind rather than a single session.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Play one of every activity type in Leonida. Open the activities list in-game and tick them off one by one — you only need to try each type, not win or master it.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Score gold on every Shooting Range challenge. Use a weapon you control well, take the challenges one at a time, and replay any that fall short of gold — the range lets you retry as often as you need.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a drone race at each Top Fun location. Learn a course's line with a practice run first, then race to win; every location counts, so check the list before you stop.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. 'Different' is the key word — repeating the same race does not count, so work through the race list across Leonida instead of grinding one favourite.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are timing-based — wait for the right moment to hook and keep the line tension steady; challenge Cal again if he wins the first round.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game. Any arcade machine in Leonida counts — pick the game you find easiest and play it through to the end.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. Andy's strand is a side-mission chain — keep taking his missions when they appear until the final one is done.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. Like the other contact strands, keep taking Kenton's missions when they appear until the final one is offered.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. Work through Billy's mission chain whenever his missions appear, and the final one closes the strand.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands. Strangers appear as markers around Leonida — take each strand to its end; you need 8 complete strands, not 8 single missions.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. Keep taking Randy's missions when they appear until the final one is done.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission. Work through Tyrone's chain whenever his missions appear; the final mission closes it.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida. Spots are scattered across the state — visit each one and meditate there; sweep the map region by region so none is missed.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret names the animal — track it in its habitat and take the shot; if it escapes, it can be tracked again.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: Finish 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — collect a complete set three times over; trade duplicates if the game allows it.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game tagging activity — use it at 100 different spots; variety of location is what counts, not repeating one spot.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. Challenges cover many kinds of play — they stack up naturally as you explore, race, hunt and fight; check the challenges menu to see which ones are close to done.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, reach a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Missable: this needs your partner present, so do it while a partner is available in the story. Get to 4 stars, break line of sight, and stay hidden until the wanted level clears.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level. Missable: needs your partner. Plan a route between three nearby shops, keep the wanted level alive between robberies, and do not let it drop before the third.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: Find 100 different vehicles. 'Discover' means encountering new vehicle types — drive around Leonida's districts, car parks and docks; rare vehicles count the same as common ones.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Defeat 5 enemies during one Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a fight with at least 5 enemies grouped together and chain the takedowns before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA airport in an unscheduled way — the description's wording points to an improvised escape from the airport. Missable: this reads as a one-off moment at the airport, so take it when the chance appears at VCIA rather than assuming it will come back.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: The description is a joke about Rhino tanks — get into a Rhino tank and cause havoc. Find a Rhino (military areas are the usual source), climb in, and the trophy follows from using it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and stay undetected the whole time. Go in quiet — avoid cameras and sightlines, take the goods, and leave before anyone raises the alarm; if you are spotted, restart the attempt.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each. Bank vaults are the big jobs — plan the getaway before you go in, and escape cleanly each time; the count is cumulative across all five.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on its route, take the cargo, and lose the responding cops.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: Visit every part of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel — drive, fly and sail into every region, including the islands and backroads, until the whole state is explored.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation from every gang. Each gang runs operations around Leonida — hit one per gang; the gangs are named in-game, so check which ones you have covered.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a bar with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, find a bar overlooking the water, and order a cocktail.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a vehicle through a showroom's frontage to break out. Take a car into a vehicle showroom and smash your way out through the glass — the 'classic style' is a straight drive-out.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go to the named alley and play a game — 'follow-through' points to completing a full game there.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague — it points to a partnership activity that draws a crowd. This reads as a side-activity trophy tied to doing a partnered activity well; check the activities tied to your partner and complete one to a high standard.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: Make a story choice. Missable: a choice trophy — the outcome you pick may lock the other path, so keep a save from before the choice if you want both outcomes across playthroughs.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: The description points to succeeding on a second attempt at something. Missable: it reads as a one-time moment where the first attempt fails and the second succeeds — play the moment through rather than reloading an earlier save.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: A story-moment trophy — it unlocks from a surprising scene in the main story. Just keep playing the story; it pops when the scene happens.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock opponents over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Drive past a group on foot and swing a melee weapon as you pass — the 'bowling' is the drive-by knockdown.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — pass them to your contacts to clean them; the total is cumulative, so keep laundering as you earn.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in shops across Leonida. Cumulative across all shops — clothes, weapons, food and cars all count; big purchases move it fastest.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property. Garages are bought with in-game money — save up and purchase each one; the map marks properties for sale.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your in-game phone and register vehicles you own or find — ten registrations in total.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.source: Official description — PSN/Exophase GTA VI trophy list.
